prompt:
Subject: eject in the sense of expel.

Composition: A hand presses the eject button on a simple disc player as a single disc slides outward on its tray. Show the tray half extended and the disc clearly leaving the machine, with no readable branding or control labels.

Style: Match only the rounded 2D style of references/invidious.png: thick dark-brown outlines, simple readable shapes, restrained cartoon shading, and friendly faces when people appear.

Framing: One coherent scene, centered, with the complete subject occupying about 80–90% of the square. Keep all essential body parts and object tips fully inside the frame without clipping.

Output: One 512 x 512 PNG with true RGBA transparency in the background and gaps. No lettering, labels, logo, watermark, or checkerboard.
